thread_analysis.thread_summary: Operational thread for Atago's Bluetooth SIG registration. Allion confirms a Receipt Number transfer completed successfully, advances the registration up to the Review Page just before final Submission, and sends a screenshot for customer confirmation — explaining a yellow TCW-related warning icon along the way. Allion also requests the four standard Compliance Folder documents (operation manual, block diagram, outline drawing, antenna datasheet) needed after registration confirmation.
all_questions_found: What does the yellow warning icon on the Review Page mean, and is it safe to proceed with Submission?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: Consistency Check conflicts inherent to the registration system are resolved via the standard Test Case Waiver (TCW) process and reviewed by SIG within 1-5 business days; this does not block the customer from approving Submission.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: System-generated registration warnings should be evaluated for whether they represent a TCW-handled system limitation (safe to proceed) versus a genuine customer-actionable issue.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Failing to explain the TCW warning proactively could cause unnecessary customer hesitation or a mistaken belief that the registration has a defect.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: None identified — Allion proactively explained the TCW warning in the same message requesting Submission approval.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Always pre-explain any visible warning icons on a Review Page screenshot sent for customer approval, rather than waiting for the customer to raise concerns.
